name: Grocy
description:
Default login is user **admin** with password **admin**, please change the password immediately (user menu at the top right corner)

## ERP beyond your fridge

grocy is a web-based self-hosted groceries & household management solution for your home

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  grocy:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/grocy:4.7.1
    container_name: grocy
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=${TZ}
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:80
